title: Why Einstein's God Letter Still Fools People
the_thought: He thought God was the order of the universe, not a person who listens.
hook: He sat down in Princeton and wrote it by hand.

levels.name: The Short
beats: The word God, he said, is nothing but human weakness. Then people called him an atheist. There's a problem. Twenty-five years earlier he told a rabbi he believed in God. Not a God who listens. The God in the laws. He thought God was the order of the universe, not a person who listens. That split lasted his whole life. The full story is on this channel.
